observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel gas cooker with two burners on the left and one larger burner on the right, with three control knobs. The surface has some stains and residue. A can of cleaning spray is visible in the background.

Photo 1 shows a different gas cooker with three burners: one large on top and two smaller ones below, with three control knobs on the right side. The surface is shiny but has some smudges. A person's foot in a sandal is visible at the bottom right.

Photo 2 shows a stainless steel gas cooker with two burners on the left and two on the right, totaling four burners, with three control knobs. The brand 'Magic' is visible on the front left. The cooker is placed on a metal stand in what appears to be a workshop or storage area.
All three photos show different gas cookers, not the same item. The seller claims a '3 in 1' gas cooker, but the photos show three distinct models with 2+1, 3, and 4 burners respectively.
The 'London' brand mentioned in the seller's words is not visible in any photo. The only visible brand is 'Magic' in photo 2.
